disease_description: The deceased developed blisters under the right breast via the back. He consulted a traditional healer. Medicine was given but blisters did not get better. Then taken to hospital. He was examined and given treatment. After some weeks blisters were healed. Then he started coughing. He was taken to Matikwana hospital. He was examined and taken to x-ray. Diagnosis was TB. He was given tablets and a letter to collect tablets every month. Cough did not get better then taken to a private doctor. He was examined and given treatment but no improvement. He was loosing weight gradually. He experienced headache and nasal bleeding. He was given tablets bought from a shop. Headache was on and off. Cough became worse then taken to Rob Ferreira hospital. He was examined and diagnosis was TB. He was given treatment and a letter to collect TB treatment every month. Afterwards he experienced difficult breathing. He was taken to a traditional healer but no change. He was sweating a lot. A day before he died, he complained about body pain. Cough and difficult breathing became worse then he died.

At first the deceased was complaining about breast pain with swollen on the left side.  Then after that the deceased experienced cold body with chilling.  She was taken to Justicia clinic where the treatment was tablets, medicine and injection.  The illness became better for a week.  It started serious where she experienced hot legs with pain.  She was taken to Belfast clinic the treatment was tablets and medicine but the illness not better.  The painful legs was worse until it was stiff and unable to walk.  Hands started to be very weak until it became stiff.  She had diarrhea and vomiting.  She experienced  difficult in breathing.  Deceased died at home after.  She was taken to Justicia clinic for several times.

She was complaining about hot feet with swelling.  She also skip days not defeacating.  She consulted Belfast Clinic twice and refered to Matikwana hospital.  She went to Matikwana hospital.  She was admitted for four weeks to get treatment.  After treatment she swelling stopped but hot pain feet sightly better.  The defeacating problem continued when defeacate will hard and round balls.  While at home start experiencing cough and energy loss.  She was taken to traditional healer thinking of tindzhaka.  After treatment cough looked better as well fatique, but hot feet, defeacating problem continued.  Afterwards she started experiencing difficult in breathing whith her eyes aching.  She consulted Matikwane hospital.  After examination deceased was transferred to Mapulaneng hospital admitted for one month diagnosis was TB and Asthma.  Released while looked better.  Then after at home cough started to be serious and she totally stop defeacating where she was taken to traditional healer.  After treatment cough sightly better, didn't defeacate.  Until death.  Then after difficult breathing became worse again, hot pain feet again started to swell.  Her whole body started to swelling.  She used to collect tablets at Matikwana hospital.  She was taken to Tintswalo hospital, admitted.  Same diagnosis (TB & Asthma) discovered, discharged while not better.  She finally died at home.

At first deceased complained headache and stomach cramps. She went to the clinic and  was given tablets to drink. After some few days headache stopped but the cramps continued. She can not urinate normally and there was also a change in her bowel movement where she could not defeacate. Again she visited clinic given treatment with no improvement. Rash developed from the chest, moving to the breast until to the back and it looked like a belt, this rash looked as blisters and it contained water. She went to faith healers and will defeacate only aftewr the enema was used and at times the stools were round little balls. Suddenly shw complained about tiredness after walking for a distance, her whole body became swollen and visited a private doctor where she was only given tablets with a referal letter to hospital, the idea was for the water to be drained. Water was drained and the blisters looked healed though she will still feel the pain inside. A day before death she vomited yellow and green substance. While at hospital she was also taken for an x-ray and it was discovered that her lungs were damaged.

Beginning of illness deceased dreamed eating food during the night.  From that time he started experiencing chest pain and body became painful.  Then he consulted hospital.  He was examined, given treatment and returned home.  Chest pain and painful body did not get better.  Then he consulted for the second time still with no improvement.  Then was taken to Matikwana hospital.  He was admitted .  Treatment was but illness could not get better.  A traditional healer was consulted with no improvement.  Then was taken to IPPC church where prayers was done but condition unchanged.  He was taken home where he died.

The deceased was not having any other illness. He was working at Pretoria. One day when he is back home during month-end, he said to his father he don't have enough power. So he was back to JHB at Pretoria. At Pretoria he manage to go to the firm only for Monday then on Tuesdays he failed to go  to work were he was taken to the hospital. He was given pill, drink medicine and injection as a treatment.

The diseased became affected while in ( Pretoria). So he didn't know what it was.  What was having is he complained firstly to his mother that he is losing power time and gain and it does not encourage him to work or walk. So these lasted for about two months in Pretoria and he was working with it. So he consulted to Pretoria clinic and it was better for a day and it pressurized again. He went to his specialist but still the doctor said he can't identity the problem. So on a month-end he come home and narrate a problem to his mother. So he returned to work but he didn't work at all. He started coughing as if there is something blocking his air passage. Coughing in the way to cleaning his throat. So they took him to Pretoria hospital. He stayed for two weeks and discharged and it was not better. So he came home being coughing and spitting sputum and he was treating highly and heavily. So they took him to a traditional healer. He was then thin and lost appetite. He disliked food and when forced eating he was vomiting. He stayed for a mouth in that traditional healer but still there was no betterment. Breathing was better and better. So they took him home to try him else where. So he just stayed two days and died at home.

He was a migrant labor in rusternburg,he come home suffering from cough, chest pain ,diarrhea and hot body .he refused to consult at the clinic, he consulted a traditional healer ,the diarrhea was better but it never stop. the swelling and coughing were worseining .he started to have difficult breathing ,he consulted at babes and he was diagnose with TB.he was by then critical ill and the diarrhea was worsening ,he died at home.

The child was taken away by her mother. After 3 months the child was taken back home. He started to ill. She was having a swollen legs and face. She started to have a diarrhoea at the same time. She was taken to clinic and she was given medicine but the diarrhoea did not stop. But after 1 week the diarrhoea stop. But he was still having swollen legs and face. But she died.

She was having a problem of stomach pain.  She started to have diarrhoe.  She was complaining about head aching, she was taken to the clinic twice.  She was given tablets and injection.  Nothing change she was still having that problem.  She was taken again to Mapulaneng hospital.  She only stay 4 days after she died.

He was on his way to Johannesburg with his brother traveling on a private car. His brother was a driver. So when passing Nelspruit and Mathafini a bakkie tyre busted and the car last control and eventually fell down. He died there instantly and his brother was injured on his left leg and he was operated in his leg. The deceased was mostly injured in his head and back.

Deceased started to bleed heavily for the whole month.  She consulted clinic, after using treatment bleeding stopped.  Her stomach became swollen.  Afterwards she started coughing.  She developed ringworms on hands spreading to whole body.  She consulted hospital where she was admitted.  Diagnosis was TB.  Cough continued and was discharged.  Rash stopped.  She was complaining of chest, body pains and headache.  She was gradually loosing weight.  Sometimes she experienced hot body and blurred vision.  Cough became worse.  She consulted another hospital, admitted for a month and discharged not better.  She consulted another hospital, admitted for a month and discharged not better.  She consulted a traditional healer who said it was a calling.  She must train to be a sangoma.  She went for the training but after few months was brought back home because coughing was worse of illness.  She stopped menstruating.  She experienced difficult breathing.  She lost appetite.

He was having headache and general body malaise.  He went to Matikwana hospital where he got tablets and medicines treatment.  The doctor told him that he has got malaria.  He went home completing the treatment.  After that he went to Jo'burg where he was working.  He was feeling better.  After some weeks the illness attacked him again.  He was still complaining about vomiting after eating.  He was also coughing.  He went to some special doctors in Jo'burg but no change.  He came back home also complaining about general body malaise and vomiting after eating.  He went to the doctor In Hazyview where he got treatment and he went for check-up.  The doctor referred him to Mapulaneng hospital.  The doctor at Mapulaneng told him that he has got Tuberculoses.  He stayed at the hospital for two weeks receiving treatment then he lost weight and sweating.  Then he died in the hospital.

The baby started complained about headache loss of appetite.  She was taken to community clinic, panado syrup, medicine to drink and tablets was given.  Conditions not changed.  Illness became worse where the baby unable to walk and talk the breathing was noisy.  Taken to Justicia clinic, same treatment plus eyes drops was given.  No improvement where she was taken to matikwana hospital.  Admitted, blood test was taken, water drip performed.  No change while at hospital.  Something like with blood was coming out from the mouth.  One of the eye burst and blood was coming out.  She was finally died at hospital after five days.  At times the baby was could but legs were always very cold since onset. Sometimes was not defecating and the stomach was noisy.

The deceased was having a headache on Saturday and started having dierrhoea in the same time.  He have liquid stools and he was also having a measles, and he was never taken to the clinic on Monday.  In the morning he died.

The problem was swollen stomach.  Her stomach was swollen and they took her to Matikwana hospital where she stayed for a week.  She was given tablets and discharged but uncured.  They tried traditional treatment but it did not help. The stomach was very swollen.  They took her to Rob Ferreira hospital and she was admitted.  She was constipated and could not pass out urine.  She relied on laxative in order to help her pass out stools.  At hospital, the doctors drained two buckets of water from her belly.  But the stomach swell although she has drained.  The feet were swollen and the private parts.  She was very thin. She was discharged being ill.  She died at home while using traditional treatment.

She started by vomiting day and night.  She was taken to the traditional healers.   The vomit after stopped after treatment.  Then after, she started having swollen stomach where she was taken to hospital.  She was admitted at hospital. They only taken her urine and blood send it to Garankuwa.  At hospital they never gave her any treatment, they said that they are waiting for the result.  She was taken back home.  And taken back to traditional healers because his swollen stomach were painful.  Nothing change, her stomach swollen as if she is expected.  Although she was given died there at the traditional healers.

The deceased complained about cough.  He started loosing weight until became abnormal thin. Cough became worse then  they thought the was suffering from Tindzhaka.  He was taken to a traditional healer where he was given treatment for Tindzhaka but cough did not get better.  Afterwards he  complained about headache, hot body as well as chills.  He consulted a private doctor after examined it was found that he was suffering from malaria.  He was sweating a lot.  Illness did not get better then taken back to a private doctor.  After examined it was found that he was dehydrated.  He was given a letter to Matikwana hospital.  The following day he was taken to Matikwana hospital.  After examined he was admitted for medication.  While at hospital he experienced mental confusion and loss of appetite.  Sometimes he refuse to eat food.  A week before death his ankles became swollen.  He also developed swellings on his jaws.  His condition became bad that he can't do anything on his own.  He finally died at hospital.

The deceased was having a painful abdomen.  Her legs started to be swollen and she was complaining of head aching.  They have taken her to the traditional healer where they have told the deceased was having ancestors.  Then she undergo for ancestors training, but her legs were still swollen and she started to cough.  And when she coughed her sputum was mixed with blood.  They also give steaming medicine, but no improvement.  One day they found her dead in her room where she was asleep.

deceased never complained of any illness, deceased had gone to Lisbon to reap oranges. When when she came back she was complaining of leg saying is paining like she have been preacked by thorn. She never follen on the tree. At home the leg started to swollen. Then the following morning she was taken to a faithy healer. They had done a prayer, before taken to a healer she was using a stick to walk. After they had pray they were back home. She was better were she was walking without a stick/knob kirrie she had stay for two weeks at the healer. At home she stay for two weeks being better but she was seems not be active. Seeing that she is not active she was taken to a traditional healer. She was given drink medicine, she stay for two months while she is there at the healer her hole body and the abdomen started to swell. From there parents hired a bakkie to take her to Matikwana hospital. She was admitted she was taken BP and parents were told to go home. The following day when they visistto the hospital they found that the lady had died.

This deceased was having a swollen stomach.  And it was painful.  She was taken to the traditional healer to give her some treatment.  He stayed at the traditional healers for 1 month try to give her some treatment.  She was given medicine for running stomach to clean the stomach, but no change.  She started those medicine, even if she was not given anything she vomited.  She was taken back home because there was no change.  She was given those traditional healers medicine being at home.  She started having diarrhea for 3 days.  The stools was black mixed with injection.  It was a bad smell.  After they have saw those infection in the stools and the blood came out.  She died.

She never fallen on the tree.  At home the leg started to swollen.  Then the following morning she was taken to a faith healer.  They had done a prayer. She was given drink medicine.  She stay for two months while he is there at the healer he whole body and the abdomen started to swell.  From there parents have hired a buckkie to take her to matikwana hospital.  She was admitted  she was taken BP and parents were told to go home.  The following day when, they visits to the hospital they found that the lady had died.

The deceased was having a problem of painful stomach and he felt something was moving inside his stomach.  It was moving up until to the chest and it made him suffocated after some few hours it move down to the abdomen.  He was taken to the private Doctor at Mkhuhlu where he was given medicine to drink.  But the treatment did not help.  When he came home his stomach started to swell and painful he was given traditional medicine to drink but the medicine never help.  He was taken back to the private doctor at Hazy view where he was told that his liver is damaged and his heart is swollen.  He was given tablets and medicine for treatment.  But never help.  He was taken to matikwana hospital where he was admitted for 1 month and they drain water from his stomach.  He came back home.  It started again the stomach became swollen andl his legs.  He started to have diarrhea but it was not frequently.  After some few days he died.

The deceased was always complaining of stomach cramps.  She felt the pains from the stomach down to the lower abdomen.  She had been ill for about 3 years.  She consulted the private doctors and they diagnosed her with ulcers.  They said she had wounds in her stomach and they were infected.  They gave her tablets and the disease seemed to be controlled for a while.  She then started to feel very sick and they took her to matikwana hospital.  There at the hospital an operation was done and it was difficult for the doctors to stitch her stomach because her flesh was infected.  Doctors tried to save her life but they failed because she died immediately after commencement of an operation.

The deceased was going to Nelspruit to buy things in order to sell it.  When he came back home.  When he reached Mkhuhlu it was late in the evening.  He was on the road trying to find a transport, while he was there came a bukkie and bit full down and die on the spot.

The deceased was a migrant worker at caraline, he came home being sick. he had hot body, he was coughing and he had difficult in breathing. he had painful right leg, where he was taken to the private doctor and x ray was done, the doctor said that his lungs was damage. nothing given, he was referred to the hospital as out patient where x ray was done. the doctors said he had TB and treatment for TB was given but nothing change. after few weeks he had chest pains and difficult in breathing was worse where he was taken to the hospital where he was admitted. the doctors said he had T.B and oxygen bottle and treatment was given but nothing change. he was abnormal thin. he died after 3 days being in the hospital

Deceased experienced diarrhoea, consulted a private doctor three times without improvement.  Diarrhoea will stop for few days and it reoccur.  His body joints were weak, legs also painful.  He was taken to the hospital, admitted and diagnosis was Tb.  Diarrhoea continued and body pains several traditional healers were also consulted with no signs of improvement.  He gradually lost weight, eyes started to discharge and realese  were sometimes painful with a strange sound.  He then started experiencing shortness breath and will feel constipated, stopped eating food and taking a lot of water.  At times his body will change color into black.  He was taken to the hospital, given treatment and returned back home.  Condition worsened and started coughing, producing a sputum.  He was taken back to hospital, admitted and released being not better.  He then went to Witbank where  illness became worse, admitted but passed away on the very same day.

The deceased complained about her feet burning and scratching, that felt like she was pricked by a thorn and started coughing and was spitting after cough. She was taken to Belfast clinic where she was diagnosed TB positive and was given treatment. She lost weight and her chest was in pain when she cough until she could no longer be able to do things by her own and had lost her skin elastic. Her body was hot and she was sweating at night. She was in pain when she swallow. She was taken to Mapulaneng and was referred to Matikwana where she was admitted for a week, given treatment but never recover. Discharged and was taken to a traditional healer and treatment was given but there was no change to the illness. Few months she developed shingles and her feet were burning and wanted to have them inside cold water. She took both traditional and western treatment for 8 months and was not helping. Due to have difficulty urinating and defaecating and sunkened eyes she died the next month.

THE DECEASED STARTED BY HAVING HOT BODY AND NO ACTION WAS TAKEN.AFTER TWO DAYS HE STARTED VOMITING WHILE COMPLAINING OF BODY PAINS.HE WAS THEN TAKEN TO THE PRIVATE CLINIC ,TREATMENT WAS GIVEN THEN THE BODY PAINS STOPS.HE STARTED EXPERIANCING THE DIARRHEOA AND CONSULTED THE TRADITIONAL HEALERS THE TRADITIONAL HERBS WAS GIVEN THE HOT BODY ,VOMIT THE DIARRHOEA NEVER STOPS.HE WAS THEN TAKEN TO THE HOSPITAL AND WAS NOT ADMITTED BUT TREATMENT AND DRIPS GIVEN BUT NOTHING HAS CHANGED.HE STARTED EXPERIANCING PROBLEM OF UNABLE TO EAT AND TO WALK THEN HE WAS TAKEN TO THE PRIVATE CLINIC AN X-RAY WAS DONE AND WAS TOLD THAT HIS LUNGS ARE DAMAGED TREATMENT AND DRIPS WAS GIVEN BUT NOTHING HAS CHANGE .HE WAS TAKEN BY AN AMBULANCE TO THE HOSPITAL WHERE HE WAS ADMITTED TREATMENT WAS GIVEN BUT NOTHING HAS CHANGE .HE STARTED HAVING DIFFICULT BREATHING WHILE IN HOSPITAL AN OXYGEN BOTTLE WAS GIVEN BUT NOTHING HAS CHANGE AND AFTER THAT HE DIED.

he started by having hot body and abscess on his penis. He was taken to private doctor where treatment was given he was better after using treatment. He started to be weak and have headache. He was taken to bhubezi and given treatment and the abscess was cured. And headache was cured too. But he was still weak and taken to clinic where treatment was given he never feels better and his legs start to be swollen he was taken to private doctor where treatment was given nothing change and head ache starts again and it was on and off. He was taken to private doctor again and given treatment. The head ache stops after treatment but he was still weak and have swollen legs. He was taken back to private doctor and referred to hospital where he was admitted drips were given but he didn’t change. He was admitted drips were given but didn’t change. He was discharged being sick. After two days being discharged he died at home.

At his work the deceased phoned the respondent telling her that his legs and lower back are paralyzed and weak and that he was unable to stand up. He felt ads if there are thorns under his feet. He was then brought home. Taken to a traditional healer and stayed for two weeks. Treatment was given but he didn’t get better and he was take not the hospital but he was not admitted he was given treatment but he didn’t get better.  He again was taken to traditional healer and the treatment continued but still, there was nothing better about him. His private part became swollen and after some few days it sank back inside his and that part became swollen and changes its colour. He was brought home where he started coughing and he couldn’t stop. He was then taken to the hospital, admitted for only one day and he passed away the following day.

she was a migrant and she fell down and collapse while working .she was rushed to the hospital .the child was phoned and told that she has been admitted that day she went there and found that she was bleeding by nose and mouth .again oxygen was given .after four days she was discharged and by then she was better .but after two days the bleeding started again and also she was complaining about chest pain since in the beginning in the middle of the night she vomited blood and her body was hot .panado tablets was bought but nothing change as every two minutes the tissues were damp she was weak and taken to the hospital where admitted for few days .at the hospital the bleeding was not frequently, but little better .the hot body was on and off, chest still paining after she was discharged being like that and at home she was having more chest pains with low energy .she loss her appetite .while given liquid things she started vomiting after vomiting liquid ,then followed and it was worse as she was also shivering .also she began to have constipation and unable to pass stools .still she continued with the treatment she was taken to the traditional healer who at the same day stopped that bleeding but referred her to the hospital for water drip. by then she was very weak and developed difficult breathing .she was taken to the hospital where admitted for few days and while there ,she developed swollen stomach. the breathing problem was getting worse as she was suffocating while sleeping .continental pillows were put on her back to support her but back was bending and always looking down when touched ,still her body was hot and also she complained about back pains she was depending on liquid things but still vomiting .she was very weak sunlit she died at the hospital .

Actually he was not ill. He was healthy and not complaining of any illness or pain. So the day it happened he was going to the bus terminal for some taxis when he suddenly fell down on the way. So he was picked home and he cannot talk, walk or breath well by then. From home they hired a vehicle that took him to hospital in Matikwana . In Matikwana he did not last, instead he died there.

At first deceased right breast became swollen, nipples very painful and a lump developed from the breast.  She went to the clinic and was given tablets to drink at home.  Traditional medicine  was then used reason being that she did no respond to the western treatment.  Suddenly the breast burst open and lot of puss came out where the breast burst open and a lot of puss came out where the breast was healed.  She then started coughing heavily and experienced difficulty when breathing.  She was then taken to hospital and was admitted, diagnosis being tb.  Water was also drained underneath her breast and after taking the treatment she felt much better because breathing was ok but could not stop coughing.  Abdomen started to swell and was taken back to hospital but stayed for few days and passed away.

The deceased experienced diarrhoea then visited a private doctor. After examined treatment given but no change. He visited private doctor several times but diarrhoea was on and off. He also complained about aching bones. Thereafter he developed rash on his face and it was itchy. He tired a traditional healer where medicine was given but diarrhoea did not get better. He was loosing weight gradually. Afterwards he developed swelling on his jaws. He also experienced hot body as well as chills. Diarrhoea became worse where he consulted several traditional healers but diarrhoea was on and off. By that time he was defecating black substance mixed with blood. His lips was very dry. His skin lost elasticity. He visited a private doctor after examined he was told that he was suffering from Aids. Treatment was given to stop diarrhoea but no improvement. On his face and hands changed colour into black. He was given medicine bought from chemist and diarrhoea will be better for short time. He also developed swelling on his groin. Sometimes experienced loss of appetite. The day he died he experienced loss of energy.

The deceased started by experiencing diarrhea and coughing. She had rash allover her body and it was itchy. She also had abscess. She was taken to the special doctor where she will always go and receive her treatment. She was not better.Diarrhoea could not stop. She started loosing weight and she became very thin. Diarrhea was on and off, it attack her for a week and stop maybe for one week, but towards death it did not stop. She would also vomit and sometimes experience dizziness. When sneezing yellow puss will come out of the nose.

Deceased started by complaining about painful legs, headache.  She was also coughing and will experience diarrhoea.  At times her body was too hot whereby she will sweat a lot.  When walking for long distances or working hard she will experience difficulty when breathing.  Traditional medicine was used and diarrhoea will sometimes stop and start again.  This had been going on for a long period and she developed sores all over her body.  Again will complain about low energy and she frequently visited the clinic but he vaginal opening as well as and opening became wide open and sometimes she will feel as if there were worms on it.  She was very aggressive and when sneezing blood will also come out and there were sores inside, also developed mouth thrush.  Illness became worse during the fourth year whereby she was unable to do anything for herself.  Legs became swollen and the cough, sometimes the voice will fade away because of the cough.  She was then taken to a traditional healer whereby western treatment was also used but she could not respond to the treatment until when she could not respond to the treatment until when she was taken to hospital, admitted and died there.

HE STARTED BY SUFFERING FROM HEADACHE HE CONSULTED AT PRIVATE DOCTORS BUT HE DID NOT GET BETTER AFTER TREATMENT .A WEEK LATER HE WAS COMPLAING OFHEST PAINS .HE RETURNED TO THE PRIVATER DOCTOR WHILE THE THE HEAD AND CHEST WERE STILL PAINFUL .THE DOCTOR REFFERED HIM TO A PUBLIC HOSPITAL . IN THE HOSPITAL HE WAS DIAGNOSED WITH TB AND GIVEN TH TB TREATMENT .THE HEADACHE GOT BETTER AFTER A MONTH BUT THE CHEST PAINS WERE WORSE HE'S LEGS WERE GETTING WEAK THAT HE COULD'NT WALK PROPERLY BY THEN HE WAS COLLECTING TB TREATMENT FROM THE CLINIC HE WAS SENT TO THE HOSPITAL AND GOT ADMITTED WHILE IN THE HOSPITAL HIS CHEST WAS GRADUALLY GETTING WORSE THAT HE WAS UNABLE TO TALK AND TO GET UP FROM A BED .HE DIED 3 WEEKS LATER IN HOSPITAL

she started by suffering from hot painful legs .she was unable to walk properly .she  was loosing weight and energy she was given tradtional treatment from a faith healer but she was not improving .she consulted at Bhubezi where she was given  types of tablets ,first taken was taken in the morning only and the other type was taken in the evening only .all the above symptoms were getting worse she consulted again at Bhubezi and she was given water drips and tablets .she started vomiting after eating food .she had very low energy and she had no appetite she was unable to do anything she consulted a private doctor who gave her water drips .she was taken to the hospital on the same day .she was admitted and given water drips  she was refusing to drink tablets .she died 4 days later in the hospital .

Deceased complained of body and chest pains at work place. He started to vomit. He consulted doctor at work. Body was also hot and was sweating. Pains got worse and came back home. On arrival he consulted matikwana hospital. He was admitted and examined. Results was that his ulcers are damaged. He refused to eat feeling pain. He was not defaecating. Illness got worse family asked for him to be discharged. He consulted a faith healer. He experienced weakness of both legs and arms. He started to talk things without sense. He experienced rapid breathing.
he was travelling on a private car they found cars piled in an accident and their car also hit the stationary cars he died on the scene immediately.
HIS HOUSE WAS BURN AND HE WAS LOCKED INSIDE IT HE DIED ON THE SCENE INSIDE THE HOUSE.

The deceased was from Ermelo where he was a passenger in a taxi. On the way the taxi driver told them the breaks were failing and the taxi  came out of the way into the veld, the taxi hit a rock and the petrol tank burst where it caused fire. He was engulfed by fire and died on the spot. He didn't have scars of fire but was black and also swollen on his face.

The deceased visited her husband when became affected by a head - ache.  She complained of a headache and bought some dispin to drink and later cough started.  She was coughing too much and head - ache stressing.  So she was always sleeping.  So husband look her to Ngodwana hospital.  In hospital they gave her pains tablets and cough medicine to drink.  So when the husband want there to see her on the second day she found her dead.

Deceased complained about painful stomach. In the middle he experienced epilepsy and on the second weeks he experienced diarrhoea for a day whereby he was very weak to such an extent that diarrhoea flowed without him reaching the toilet. He was taken to hospital where he was admitted and passed away on the second day.

She started having a swollen legs, face and hands, and she stanted to vomited, when she eat she vomited, she was taken to Belfast clinic, At the clinic they said that she was having a khoishor and she was Panodo and syrup and 1 bottle of Peanut butter.  And she was taken back home.  But there was nothing change, she was given traditional medicine, butter nothing change.  She was taken back to the hospital at Matikwana,  she was admitted and she was given treatment, Panado.  Only she only stay for two weeks at the hospital after she died.

She was complaining of chest pain.  And she was coughing and she was taken to the traditional healer and she was given treatment, to drink.  But nothing change the pain on her chest become worst when she walk.  And he said that all body was painful.  She was taken to Matikwane hospital and he was admitted there and he stay and her stomach become swollen and her legs become swollen.  In the X - ray they found that her lungs was damaged.  They have try to heat her for 3 month, but nothing become better.   She died there.

Intially the deceased about stomach ache which later caused abdominal swellings.  During this period he also changed the colour of eyes to yellow.  With this he was taken to  Matikwana hospital but with no effect.  At Matikwana hospital he was given powder medicine realizing that the was no effect he was taken home.  To be treated by the traditional doctors.  He received traditional medicine until he died after two days from the hospital.  He also complained about hot body.
